descriptions.notStarted: I should go see Porter of the Omega Sector.
descriptions.inProgress: #bPorter#k, who's at the Command Center in the Omega Sector, requested that I deliver a letter to #bKay the Engineer#k at the Omega Sector Silo. This letter has to be delivered on time, so I'll have to hurry up and give it to her. I wonder what's written in this though... maybe it's a love letter. Hahaha.
descriptions.completed: I gave Kay the Engineer, who was at the Omega Sector Silo, the letter from Porter. Unfortunately, it doesn't look like a love letter. It's about a disappeared Dropship
